title: Lebanese Spinach Falafel Pita & Fetta Fries
subtitle: with Cos Salad & Mint Yoghurt
description: Get a taste of Beirut with these golden falafel pita pockets, packed with crunchy cos and a refreshing mint yoghurt. We’ve paired them with our famous fetta fries for a salty, cheesy kick that makes this veggie feast a total winner.

steps.text:
•

• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. Cut sweet potato into fries. 
• Place on a lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with everything garnish 
and toss to coat. Bake until tender, 20-25 minutes. 
• In the last 5 minutes of cook time, remove from oven, crumble over fetta cubes 
and bake until cheese is golden and slightly softened.  
TIP: If your oven tray is crowded, divide fries between two trays.

•

• Meanwhile, finely shred baby cos lettuce (see ingredients). 
• Slice cucumber into thin rounds. Roughly chop tomato.
• Pick and thinly slice mint leaves. 
• In a small bowl, combine Greek-style yoghurt and mint. Season to taste with 
salt and pepper and set aside.

•

• When the fries have 10 minutes remaining, set your air fryer to 200°C. 
• Place spinach falafel in air fryer basket. Brush or spray with a drizzle of olive oil 
and bake until golden and heated through, 5-6 minutes. 
• Bake pita bread directly on a wire oven rack until heated through, 2-3 minutes.  
TIP: No air fryer? In a large frying pan, heat a geneous drizzle of olive oil over 
medium-high heat. When oil is hot, cook spinach falafel, turning halfway, until golden 
brown, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.

•

• Halve falafel (if preferred). 
• Halve pita bread and spread with garlic sauce. Fill with some cos, tomato, 
cucumber and falafel. Drizzle with mint yoghurt. 
• Divide Lebanese spinach falafel pitas between plates. 
• Serve with fetta fries and any remaining veggies. Enjoy!
